source.author: ov
source.text: Hunc ego sanguineae successu caedis ovantem eminus ingenti resupinum pondere fudi, hunc ego poscentem, cum quo concurreret, unus sustinui, sortemque meam vovistis, Achivi, et vestrae valuere preces!
source.text_original: Hunc ego sanguineae successu caedis ovantem / eminus ingenti resupinum pondere fudi, / hunc ego poscentem, cum quo concurreret, unus / sustinui, sortemque meam vovistis, Achivi, / et vestrae valuere preces!
source.text_english: I felled him, exulting in the success of bloody slaughter, by a great blow from afar, and toppled him backward; I alone withstood him when he demanded one to meet him in combat, and you, Achaeans, vowed my fate, and your prayers prevailed!

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed patriae valuere preces auditaque magnis vota deis: video nostro tot in aequore reges teque ducem.
reuse.text_original: sed patriae valuere preces auditaque magnis / vota deis: video nostro tot in aequore reges / teque ducem.
reuse.text_english: But the prayers for his country prevailed, and vows were heard by the great gods: I see so many kings in our sea, and you as leader.
